In Pebble Hill (Tsawwassen), Delta, the 55+ homes you can buy are Tsawwassen Greene (strata). This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
55+ strata buildings you can buy in Pebble Hill (Tsawwassen)

Freehold strata condo, built 1991 (one building source lists 1990), 27 units in the building source; current MLS listing text states "Age restricted 55+," with one dog or cat allowed to 12 inches at the shoulder (listing-stated — confirm in the bylaws).
Streets, schools and getting around Pebble Hill (Tsawwassen)

items.t: Pebble Hill is a sub-area of Tsawwassen, one of the City of Delta's communities in South Delta, planned under the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future," Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan with no Tsawwassen area-plan schedule.
The name on the ground: the City of Delta lists Pebble Hill Park at 411 Milsom Wynd, and the BC Ministry of Education lists Pebble Hill Traditional Elementary at 246 52A St among SD37's schools.

The live page's listing feed for the sub-area showed detached homes on Cedar Crescent, 3rd Avenue, Rosehill Wynd, 4th Avenue, 54 Street, 2 Avenue, 50 Street and 49 Street — the detached street pattern that defines the pocket. The board sub-area code is UNVERIFIED.

Where 55+ housing actually concentrates in Tsawwassen: not here. The verified 55+ strata are on 54A Street and 55 Street in Tsawwassen Central, around the KinVillage campus at 54A Street and 10 Avenue, north-west of this pocket.
Health: the nearest hospital is Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner — Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta with 24/7 emergency care.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Pebble Hill (Tsawwassen)

items.t: City zoning: Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017: is Delta's zoning bylaw; seniors housing in Delta is typically delivered through site-specific comprehensive development zones (The Waterford's site is CD Zone No. 276, permitting seniors' congregate housing and a seniors' congregate care facility).

"Seniors congregate housing" is a named use in Delta's newer apartment zones: The Apartment Residential 6 (RA6) zone added to Bylaw No. 7600 lists apartment building and seniors congregate housing as principal uses, for six-storey residential development along arterial and collector streets under the OCP's Neighbourhood Centres and Corridors designation.

OCP: Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 8400, 2024 ("Housing Our Future"): is Delta's current OCP — a single consolidated plan whose land-use designations sit in its Land Use Plan (s. 1.5); there is no Tsawwassen area-plan schedule in Bylaw 8400.

Small-scale multi-unit housing: Delta's SSMUH rules allow up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots city-wide, subject to the bylaw and to any hazard or streamside permit area on the lot — the legal route for a 55+ Pebble Hill owner to add a suite or coach house for a caregiver or family member.
Property taxes: Delta's 2026 property tax due date was July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding balances after that date and a further 5% after September 2, 2026.

Tax relief that matters at 55+: the Province's Benefits Connector states the regular property tax deferment loan program is for people 55 and older (plus surviving spouses and persons with disabilities), and the additional home owner grant (total $845 in Metro Vancouver / Fraser Valley) is for seniors 65+.
Subsidized seniors rental runs through BC Housing's Housing Registry: (Zone 3 — Richmond and West Delta directory, May 2025), which is how the KinVillage subsidized units are filled.

Good to know about Pebble Hill (Tsawwassen)

items.t: Pebble Hill's name is carried by a park and a school, not by a plan. The City lists Pebble Hill Park (411 Milsom Wynd) and SD37 lists Pebble Hill Traditional Elementary (246 52A St); the sub-area name itself is the board's, and the City publishes no separate Pebble Hill plan or boundary.

The 55+ cluster one pocket over is mid-rebuild. In Tsawwassen Central, KinVillage's The Tides (152 homes) replaced the 86-home North Court building, and Phase 2 at 1050 54A Street (143 more affordable seniors rental units plus a replacement community centre, City File LU009921) is in the rezoning process.

Delta's 2024 OCP quietly removed the old area plans. Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) is a single consolidated plan with no Tsawwassen area-plan schedule — the schedules buyers and agents still cite belonged to the superseded OCP Bylaw No. 3950.

Seniors congregate housing is now a named principal use in Delta's RA6 apartment zone — the zoning route for future purpose-built seniors buildings along Delta's arterial and collector corridors, added to Zoning Bylaw No. 7600.

School catchments do not follow the sub-area names. SD37 catchments are address-based; a Tsawwassen North sample address returned Ladner Elementary and Delta Secondary in the district locator during this program's research — run the exact address rather than assuming.

faq.q: Is there any 55+ building right in Pebble Hill?
faq.a: No — none was verified in any source. The sub-area's confirmed stock is detached houses; the nearest verified 55+ ownership is in Tsawwassen Central (The Lexington, 1150 54A St; Tsawwassen Greene, 1140 55 St).

faq.q: I want a detached house but in a 55+ setting. What is the closest match in Delta?
faq.a: South Pointe in Ladner's Neilsen Grove — a gated 55+ bare land strata of detached single-level ranchers on their own strata lots (plan NWS2528, built 1989). Buyers own the strata lot and the house; the strata carries the gates, roads and common landscaping.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or a coach house to a Pebble Hill house for a caregiver or my parents?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH rules allow up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots city-wide, subject to the zoning bylaw and to any hazard or streamside permit area on the lot. Confirm the specific lot's permit areas with the City before designing.
Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner — Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta with a 24/7 emergency department.

Flood protection in Delta is a city-wide system: the City is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure — lot-level flood construction requirements still have to be checked parcel by parcel.

faq.q: What help exists if I want subsidized or below-market seniors rental in Tsawwassen instead of buying?
faq.a: KinVillage in Tsawwassen Central: The Tides (152 homes — 106 subsidized, 46 market rental) and the independent-living courts, with eligibility including age 55 or older and subsidized rent at 30% of household gross income through BC Housing's Housing Registry.

faq.q: Are pets allowed in the Tsawwassen 55+ buildings?
faq.a: Building by building: The Lexington's sources record one pet allowed but no dogs; Tsawwassen Greene's listing records one dog or cat to 12 inches at the shoulder. KinVillage's rental buildings do not allow pets. Confirm in the strata bylaws / tenancy documents for the specific building.
